title: Largest of Three Numbers
statement:
You are given three integers `a`, `b` and `c`. Print the largest of them.

Some of the numbers may be equal; in that case the largest value is still printed once. Numbers may be negative.

**Follow-up:** do it using only comparisons (no built-in `max`), and think about how many comparisons are needed in the worst case.
inputFormat: Three integers `a`, `b` and `c`, separated by whitespace.
outputFormat: Print a single integer: the largest of the three numbers.

examples.explanation: All numbers are negative; -2 is the closest to zero, so it is the largest.
Two numbers tie for the largest value, 7, which is printed once.

hints: Compare the first two numbers and keep the larger one.
Compare that winner with the third number.
